name: end card: cursive wordmark, promise and a credit-led CTA
looks: On a plain white field, a cursive script wordmark settles above a short promise line. A dark pill button arrives last, naming a free start with a small credit amount, and a last, fine-print line of terms sits quietly beneath it.
build: The wordmark and promise line arrive together, y:8-12px->0, opacity 0->1, power2.out, 300-400ms; the CTA pill follows 150-200ms later with a touch of scale overshoot (0.95->1.02->1); the fine print fades in last at low opacity, no motion.
sound: A soft low swell fading out under the hold, nothing new once the pill lands.
prompt: Close on the brand's cursive wordmark and a one-line promise settling together on a plain field. Let a dark call-to-action pill arrive last with a small bounce, naming a low-risk way to start, and fade in a quiet line of fine print beneath it. Hold the finished card without further motion.
